[[C.S. Emelec|Emelec]] were the defending champions. First stage winners [[L.D.U. Quito|LDU Quito]] defeated second stage winners and defending champions Emelec 2–1 on aggregate in the final (third stage) to win their eleventh domestic title.{{cite web|url=https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/liga-quito-emelec-final-campeonato.html|language=es|work=elcomercio.com|date=16 December 2018|title=Liga de Quito derrotó 1-0 a Emelec y es el campéon del Ecuador 2018}} ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in the 2018 Serie A season, ten of whom took part in the previous season. [[C.D. Clan Juvenil|Clan Juvenil]] and [[Fuerza Amarilla S.C.|Fuerza Amarilla]] were relegated from the Serie A after accumulating the fewest points during the [[2017 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2017 season]]. They were replaced by [[C.D. Técnico Universitario|Técnico Universitario]] and [[S.D. Aucas|Aucas]], the 2017 Serie B winner and runner-up, respectively. Técnico Universitario were in their 25th top-flight appearance and their first one since 2012, while Aucas returned to the Serie A for their 37th appearance after just one season in the second tier. === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2018 Serie A teams. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-2.186101 |long=-79.924885 |label=
